sport/basketball.title: Surebets on basketball
sport/basketball.metaTitle: Basketball surebets – guaranteed profit on NBA and Euroleague
sport/basketball.description: Find basketball surebets on NBA, Euroleague and European leagues. Points markets and handicaps create numerous arbitrage opportunities with licensed bookmakers.
sport/basketball.intro: Basketball offers numerous surebets on points totals and handicaps. The NBA features extensive betting markets, and bookmakers adjust their lines at different speeds, creating arbitrage opportunities.

blocks.text: Popular markets for basketball arbing

items: Match winner including overtime: two outcomes and straightforward calculation.
Over/under total points, for example over or under 215.5 points.
Points handicap, where the favourite must win by a specified margin.
Player-specific markets such as points scored, rebounds and assists.

blocks.text: Middling on points totals

With points markets, two bookmakers may offer different lines, for example over 214.5 at one and under 216.5 at another. If the match finishes on exactly 215 or 216 points, you win both bets. This is called a 'middle' and represents an additional profit opportunity in basketball.
Check whether overtime counts. In basketball it almost always does, but not at all bookmakers on every market.

faq.q: Does overtime count in basketball surebets?
faq.a: For most markets yes, but always check the specific market rules at each bookmaker. A market excluding overtime cannot be combined with one that includes overtime for arbitrage purposes.

faq.q: What time are NBA games usually played?
faq.a: NBA games are typically played during the evening in North America. Depending on your time zone, many surebets may appear several hours before tip-off, giving you time to place both sides of the arbitrage bet.

sport/ishockey.title: Ice hockey surebets
sport/ishockey.metaTitle: Ice hockey surebets – guaranteed profit on NHL & leagues
sport/ishockey.description: Ice hockey surebets from NHL, SHL and other leagues. Learn the difference between regulation-time and winner markets, and find guaranteed profit opportunities.
sport/ishockey.intro: Ice hockey is an underrated sport for surebets. Many bookmakers price the Nordic leagues differently, and the distinction between regulation-time and winner markets creates additional opportunities for arbitrage betting.

blocks.text: Regulation time or including overtime?

In ice hockey, there is both a 1X2 market for regulation time only and a winner market including overtime and shootouts. These two must never be mixed in the same surebet. Always check which market you are betting on with each bookmaker before placing your bets.
Good leagues for ice hockey surebets

items: NHL: many matches and high maximum stakes.
SHL and Liiga: popular in the Nordic region and priced differently by bookmakers.
Domestic leagues: smaller leagues where bookmakers often disagree on pricing.

blocks.text: Ice hockey often offers high profit per surebet, but lower maximum stakes than football.

faq.q: Can you combine 1X2 and winner including overtime in an ice hockey surebet?
faq.a: No. These are two different markets. If you combine them, you can lose both bets if the match goes to overtime. Always ensure all legs of your arbitrage bet are on the same market type.

faq.q: Are there surebets on smaller ice hockey leagues?
faq.a: Yes. Bookmakers often price smaller domestic leagues differently, so arbitrage opportunities arise regularly. Check that bookmakers are licensed to operate in your country before betting.

sport/fodbold.title: Surebets on football
sport/fodbold.metaTitle: Football surebets – find guaranteed profit on matches
sport/fodbold.description: Find surebets on football in real time. BetTrackerAI scans odds across the Premier League, Champions League and hundreds of other leagues at licensed bookmakers.
sport/fodbold.intro: Football produces more surebets than any other sport. Matches are played around the clock, and each fixture offers hundreds of markets that bookmakers price differently.

blocks.text: Why football produces so many surebets

Bookmakers must price thousands of football matches every week, from the Champions League down to lower divisions. The smaller the league, the less time bookmakers devote to it, and the greater the likelihood of pricing discrepancies that create arbitrage opportunities.
The most commonly used markets

items: 1X2: home win, draw and away win. Three outcomes, so you need three bets.
Over/under goals, for example over or under 2.5 goals. Only two outcomes and often high liquidity.
Asian handicap: two outcomes and low margin, but read the settlement rules for half and whole goals carefully.
Both teams to score: yes or no. A straightforward market with two outcomes.

blocks.text: Always check whether the market applies to normal time only. Extra time and penalties rarely count in football surebets.
When do surebets arise?

Many football surebets emerge when team line-ups are announced roughly an hour before kick-off. Some bookmakers adjust quickly, others react more slowly, and pricing differences appear in that window.

faq.q: Which football leagues have the most surebets?
faq.a: Smaller leagues often offer higher profit percentages, but major leagues like the Premier League and Champions League have more markets and higher maximum stakes.

faq.q: Can you place surebets on live football matches?
faq.a: Yes, but live odds change very quickly. It requires you to place both bets within a few seconds.

sport/esport.intro: Esports features large price differences between bookmakers. The market is relatively new, many bookmakers have fewer specialists in the field, and odds often move significantly before match start.

blocks.text: Why esports yields high profit

Bookmakers dedicate fewer resources to esports than to football, and news about team line-ups spreads quickly within the community. This creates larger odds differences and often higher profit per surebet.
Popular games for arbitrage betting

items: Counter-Strike 2: the most matches and markets for map and round handicaps.
League of Legends: major tournaments with stable markets.
Dota 2: high odds differences, but lower maximum stakes.

blocks.text: Watch out for postponed matches. Bookmakers have different rules for how long a bet remains valid.

faq.a: Yes, the profit is often higher than in traditional sports. However, the maximum stakes are typically lower.
Most major licensed bookmakers offer esports, especially CS2 and League of Legends. Check availability and licence in your country.

sport/tennis.title: Surebets on Tennis
sport/tennis.metaTitle: Tennis Surebets – Guaranteed Profit on ATP, WTA & Challenger
sport/tennis.description: Tennis is ideal for surebets: only two outcomes and year-round matches. Find tennis arbitrage opportunities on ATP, WTA and Challenger tournaments worldwide.
sport/tennis.intro: Tennis is the preferred sport for many sure bettors. There are only two outcomes, no draw, and tournaments take place almost every single day of the year.

blocks.text: The Advantages of Tennis

items: Only two outcomes, so you only need to place two bets.
No draw, which makes the calculation simple.
Plenty of matches at Challenger and ITF level, where bookmakers often disagree.
Matches around the clock due to tournaments in different time zones.

blocks.text: Beware of Retired Matches

The biggest risk in tennis is when a player retires from a match. Bookmakers have different rules: some void the bet, others settle it if the first set has been completed. If your two bookmakers use different rules, you could lose both bets.
Read the bookmakers' rules for retired tennis matches before placing your first tennis surebet.
Other Markets
Besides the match winner, there are surebets on total games, set handicaps and individual set winners. These markets often have lower maximum stakes.

faq.a: Yes. Only two outcomes and plenty of matches make tennis one of the best sports for surebets, especially for beginners.

faq.q: What happens if a player retires?
faq.a: It depends on the bookmaker. Some void all bets, others settle them if a certain number of sets have been played. Check the rules at both bookmakers.
